split: Previously reviewed development photos, not independent test
question: Can original reviewed SKEL face bindings query NLF canonical points directly, and how do these predictions differ from fitted-mesh propagation?
binding: 37 original ordered face vertex indices and barycentric weights, applied to official NLF canonical SMPL vertices. No nearest-neighbor projection and no side flips.
controls: Same DEV40 original RGB, bbox and K; frozen NLF v0.3.2.patch4, num_aug=1. Reuse prior frozen SAM and NLF parametric meshes.
queries: 37 barycentric positions plus 102 unique support vertices, total139 in one query set
comparisons: NLF fitted SMPL with original SKEL binding
Direct point versus barycentric interpolation of directly queried support vertices
metrics: Distances between model outputs only. No new 37-point ground truth, no clinical or real-surface accuracy claim.
visibility: No calibrated visibility filter. Visualizations include all 37 predictions, including uncertain or potentially occluded points.
